**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 23:15
- [FACT] The text analyzed is a resolution from the Kherson District Zemstvo Assembly dated June 26, 1917.
- [FACT] The resolution states that Ukraine should be part of the federal-democratic Russian Republic as a national territorial autonomous unit.
- [FACT] The Kherson district has 75% of the Ukrainian population.
- [FACT] H. A. Morgun was elected as a delegate to the Ukrainian Congress in Odesa.
- [FACT] The Ukrainian Central Council was allocated 10,000 karbovanets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant summarized that the resolution supports the Ukrainian Central Rada and allocates funds to the Ukrainian Central Council.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant stated that the state to which Ukraine belongs should be a federal democracy, allowing for autonomy as a national territorial unit.
- [USER] Asked what kind of system should be in the state to which Ukraine belongs.
- [USER] Inquired if the Kherson province supported the Central Rada.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that the text does not mention the overall support of the Kherson province for the Central Rada, only that the Kherson District Zemstvo Assembly recognized the demands of the Universal Central Rada.
- [USER] Asked how Ukraine associated itself with Kherson province.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that the Kherson district, despite being the most Russified, is considered part of the Ukrainian regions due to its significant Ukrainian population, but the nature of the association was not clear from the text.
